propositions: The code-review documentation specialist currently uses single-turn execution mode which withholds repository tools, preventing grounded detection of public contract changes requiring documentation updates.
The diff-only contradiction rule prevents detection of missing updates when a changed public contract (user, operator, API, CLI, configuration, or help) has no corresponding documentation change.
The current rubric does not apply documentation roles and correction rules from docs/documentation-policy.md and docs/generated-artifacts.md.

The approved design upgrades the specialist to agentic execution with read-only repository navigation and a two-source evidence rule requiring both a changed path:line citation and a second repository source proving inaccuracy or bounded omission.

Eval cases with repository files must execute against a disposable fixture repository with rerooted runner, while inline cases preserve existing execution path, and the documentation spec must include repository-backed fire cases and bounded no-fire cases with deterministic scorers.
